name: Sword Legends Simulator [UPDATE]
desc:
Welcome to Sword Legends Simulator!

-Swing your sword to gain power!
-Get strong and fight other people!
-Climb on the top of the leaderboard!
-Get better swords to get more power and rebirth!

Note: You can still buy previous exclusive swords in the GamePasses section
Inspired by Firemalte07s Sword Simulator
_______________________________________________________________
The game discontinuation has been cancelled. Game will continue updating, but all events will be differentiated.
